name: Mischief
body:
School illusion; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Area 10-foot-radius burst
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the area with whimsical magic, the nature of the burst depends upon the caster.

Roll on Table: Random Mishaps each round to determine the effect upon any creatures in the area. Each round after the first, you can move the area of the spell 10 feet before you determine the effect. The center of the area must remain within close range or the spell ends prematurely.

Random Mishaps
d4	Effect
1	The area is filled with a warm, sweet, comforting smell. All creatures in the area must make a Will save or be affected as though by the charm person spell for 1 round.
2	Flowers or bursts of colorful powders fill the air. All creatures in the area must make a Reflex save or be blinded for 1 round.
3	A disembodied voice says something that all the creatures in the area find funny in their own language. They must make a Will save or be overcome with giggling and become staggered for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting effect.
4	A sticky, multi-colored substance floats and fills the area causing difficult terrain for all movement types for 1 round.
